title: Product of all other elements
summary: Give everyone in a group photo the product of everybody else's numbers, using one pass from the left and one from the right.
goal: Give each person the product of everyone else's numbers

examples.label: Four people
examples.explanation: The person holding 1 scores 2 × 3 × 4 = 24, and so on.

examples.label: A zero
examples.explanation: Only the person holding 0 avoids multiplying by 0.

ladder.name: Multiply everyone else
ladder.idea: For each person, multiply all the other numbers.

ladder.name: Left products and right products
ladder.idea: Write the product of everyone to the left of each person, and of everyone to the right. Each score is the two multiplied.
ladder.insight: Everyone else is exactly the people on the left times the people on the right, and both can be built as running products.

ladder.name: Fold the right pass into the answer
ladder.idea: Store the left products in the answer list, then walk from the right with one running product, multiplying it in.
ladder.insight: The right products are used once each, in order from the right, so a single running number replaces their list.

transfer.problem: For each day, compute the total sales of every other day of the week, without subtracting from the weekly total.
transfer.explanation: Everything except one position is everything before it plus everything after it: prefix and suffix running totals.

selfCheck: Uses running products from both sides.
Handles a zero, and two zeros.
Uses O(1) extra space besides the answer.
